captions.detailed: This is a low-profile benchtop monocular microscope with a thick, rounded light-gray base and a short, stout curved support arm. An angled, cylindrical black eyepiece is mounted on top of a light-gray head carriage. Below the head carriage is a rotating, dark-gray objective nosepiece with multiple objectives. A flat, black square specimen stage is mounted on a sliding carrier, allowing left-to-right prismatic adjustment, while the head carriage slides vertically along a rear guide track.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a low-profile benchtop monocular microscope using CadQuery. The model must feature a thick rounded rectangular base, a curved vertical arm, a flat black square stage, and an angled cylindrical eyepiece. It should include three articulations: a vertical prismatic joint for the head carriage, a horizontal prismatic joint for the stage carrier, and a continuous rotational joint for the objective nosepiece.
captions.factory: Create an ArticulatedObject containing several parts. Construct the base and arm using a rounded box and extruded profiles to form the curved support frame. Model the stage as a flat black box and mount it on a prismatic joint to slide horizontally. Build the head carriage using a box and an angled cylinder for the eyepiece, mounting it on a vertical prismatic joint along the arm. Finally, model the objective nosepiece as a cylinder with smaller objective cylinders, connected to the head carriage via a continuous rotational joint.
